_doc: Dark basalt / ash massif pieces for wasteland ranges: the same footprints and canvases as massif-granite (see its _doc and docs/art/MASSIF_ART.md), jagged dark volcanic rock with blocky columns and pale ash dust on the tops instead of snow. generate-image-v2 with an accepted granite piece as the style image but without copying its palette (style_options color_palette false). Palette: lit basalt #6c6a78, mid #57556a, shade #34323e, ash dust #b9b2a6, outline near black #1e1c24; darker than the ash ground so the range reads by value. Layers: style, light, class-massif, subject. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead.

recipes.subject: Subject: one huge dark volcanic basalt mountain massif seen from the south, as tall as it is wide: it fills almost the whole image, its summits a little below the top edge, its foot along the bottom edge and its flanks reaching the left and right edges. Two jagged summits of different heights joined by a shoulder, blocky columnar basalt cliffs and ledges down the front, pale grey ash dust on the summits instead of snow, a ragged foot of a few dark boulders. Lit faces slate basalt #6c6a78, shaded faces #34323e, ash dust #b9b2a6, outline near black #1e1c24. One solid mass, not separate cones.
